name: T-box transcription factor 2

function.text: TBX2 is the approved symbol for T-box transcription factor 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; DNA-binding transcription factor binding; aorta morphogenesis.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Low-grade glioma; Hepatocellular carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: TBX2 encodes T-box transcription factor 2. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TBX2 have been reported in low-grade glioma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.
